title: Human resources manager
description: JOB OVERVIEW:  The Human Resources Manager plays a pivotal role in partnering with leadership to strategically coordinate the full employee lifecycle, from talent acquisition and onboarding to fostering continuous faculty and staff development. This role is crucial in ensuring successful integration into EAC's unique school culture and actively championing school-wide well-being initiatives.  ORGANIZATIONAL RESULTS:  Talent Development & Retention  Collaborates with school Leadership to monitor and administer professional development programs, ensuring alignment with local and international best practices in areas such as evidence-based instructional strategies and leadership development frameworks.  Maintains an accurate database of professional development experiences to inform future planning and ensure equitable allocation of resources.  Develops and implements career progression frameworks and provides individualized guidance in career development.  Proactively identifies and organizes relevant professional development opportunities (e.g., workshops, speakers, Ed Camps).  Attracting & Retaining Talent  Manages the advertisement of positions and ensures the revision of job descriptions, interview questions, and tracking the overall hiring process, in collaboration with hiring managers.  Actively sources and solicits qualified applicants, reviews resumes, conducts initial and subsequent interviews, checks background on applicants, and makes recommendations to hiring managers, as requested.  Assists the Director of Finance and Administration in conducting compensation benchmarking and analysis, and utilizes systems to collect and analyze data on staff development, evaluation, retention, and attrition.  Organizes an overall calendar and individual events which recognize and celebrate the commitment of faculty & staff to EAC, fostering a positive and appreciative work environment.  Conducts interviews with faculty & staff as part of talent assessment and retention efforts.  Supporting performance reviews, tracking goal progress.  Actively sources and solicits qualified applicants from diverse backgrounds, reviews resumes with an equity lens, conducts initial and subsequent interviews, and makes recommendations to hiring managers, as requested, promoting a diverse candidate pool.  Supporting a Positive & Ethical Culture  Administers employment contracts and oversees the comprehensive onboarding process for all new staff, including a schedule of activities, and facilitates training in child protection and data protection.  Provides comprehensive support and resources to foreign hire staff as they settle into life in Campinas and at EAC.  Plans and implements outings for staff to support inclusion and celebration of the local culture of Campinas.  Collaborates with school Leadership to monitor and administer professional development programs, ensuring alignment with local and international best practices in areas such as evidence-based instructional strategies, leadership development frameworks, and DEIJ best practices.  Compliance and Child Protection  Collaborates with outsourced providers to ensure effective monitoring of EAC's complaint channel, facilitating appropriate incident reporting, including CIPA compliance.  Develops and delivers appropriate compliance training to staff and ensures the fully compliance with HR related laws  Establishes and oversees a robust school-wide system for mandatory child protection training for all EAC staff and third-party providers (liaising with counseling staff and Leadership).  Stays abreast of compliance-related laws and best practices in human resources, both nationally and internationally.  Proactively proposes and implements policy and procedure enhancements that support ethical behavior at EAC.  Develops and implements safer hiring protocols, including enhanced interview processes and comprehensive background, social media, and reference checks.  Wellbeing  Recommends a comprehensive yearly plan, in line with the school's strategic direction, articulating meaningful developments in all aspects of staff wellness.  Conducts research and benchmarking exercises to ensure EAC's approach to staff wellness incorporates new ideas and initiatives.  Establishes mechanisms for regular staff feedback on wellness initiatives, utilizing data to inform continuous improvement.  Collaborates with Leadership to research and recommend new benefits for inclusion in EAC's approach to staff wellness.  Health (physical and mental/emotional) Develops, promotes, and publishes a comprehensive yearly plan of offerings and events at EAC that support the health and wellbeing of all faculty & staff.  Develops and promotes wellbeing activities for faculty & staff, making use of local resources such as guest speakers and trainers.  Acts as a primary resource, providing advice and guidance to staff on personal wellbeing, and sharing awareness of internal and external resources.  Serves as an internal consultant for faculty and staff on personal matters, such as stress management and relationships, offering evidence-based strategies and resources to support mental health and wellbeing and foster coping mechanisms.  Other duties, as assigned.  POSITION REQUIREMENTS  BA in Human Resources, Psychology, or related field 5+ years of experience  HR policies, procedures, and best practices  Labor laws, employment regulations, and compliance (including CIPA) HR Information Systems (HRIS) Full recruitment and onboarding lifecycle  Compensation, benefits, and benchmarking  Professional development and training frameworks  Child protection and safeguarding protocols  Cultural competence and sensitivity.  Languages level requirement: B2 in English and C1 or above in Portuguese  Other Skills (Desirable):  Excellent communication (verbal and written) Strong organizational and time management abilities  High attention to detail  Problem-solving and conflict resolution  Interpersonal skills and empathy  Confidentiality and discretion  Data analysis  Adaptability and proactivity  Cultural awareness and sensitivity  Ability to foster an inclusive and equitable workplace culture.  Child Safeguarding  Our school is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and have developed and adopted written guidelines (Code of Conduct) for appropriate and inappropriate behavior of adults towards children. We expect all staff, volunteers and other third parties to share this commitment and to review and affirm that they have read, understood, and will abide by the Code of Conduct. At our school, we use safer recruitment practice and pre-employment background checks, to maintain the highest standards of safeguarding and child safety.  EAC’s Statement of Diversity and Inclusion  EAC embodies inclusion and diversity. As a community, we embrace the truth that diversity enriches us as individuals and as a community. Diversity includes recognizing individual differences in relation to cultural backgrounds, age, abilities, religious beliefs, gender and gender expression, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, religious beliefs, political beliefs, or other ideologies. The multiplicity of backgrounds and perspectives within our community reflect the entire world. Thus, we work to ensure that all members of our community enjoy mutual respect, are valued for who they are, and share a sense of belonging.

title: Sdr outbound

title: Preschool teaching assistant (maternity cover)
description: JOB OVERVIEW:  The Teaching Assistant at EAC is dedicated to the school’s mission, vision, and core values, demonstrating respect for diverse cultures and learners. Teaching Assistants (TAs) play an essential role in supporting high-quality, inquiry-based international education within the Montessori and IB Primary Years Programme (PYP). Assigned to one classroom or one subject area for the school year, Teaching Assistants collaborate closely with the Specialist, Homeroom, and/or Brazilian Studies teacher to support student learning, provide individualized assistance, and foster an environment of care and belonging.  Teaching Assistants contribute to planning, instruction, assessment, and supervision, ensuring students are safe, engaged, and supported academically, socially, and emotionally. As active members of the Professional Learning Community, they participate in professional development and continuous reflection to enhance their effectiveness in supporting student growth.  ORGANIZATIONAL RESULTS:  Contribute to a safe, inclusive, and caring learning environment aligned with EAC’s mission and values.  Support the effective delivery of the school curriculum and programs by reinforcing learning and differentiated instruction.  Foster student well-being, independence, and positive relationships within the classroom and broader school community.  Model professionalism, collaboration, and ethical conduct in alignment with school policies and expectations.  CORE RESPONSIBILITIES:  Instructional Support and Student Learning  Collaborate with the classroom teacher to plan and deliver structured learning experiences for the whole class, small groups, and individual students.  Support students in understanding and reinforcing concepts introduced by the teacher, promoting independence and confidence in learning.  Prepare and organize resources, adapting materials and strategies to meet diverse student needs and cultural backgrounds.  Assist in providing formative feedback and collecting academic and behavioral data as directed by the teacher.  Participate in meetings and conferences, sharing relevant insights on student learning and providing translation or language support, when needed.  Student Care and Learning Environment  Help establish and maintain a positive, proactive, and fair classroom environment that promotes respect and self-management.  Supervise and support students to ensure safety and engagement during class and non-class times (breaks, lunch, transitions, etc.).  Apply logical and natural consequences in alignment with teacher expectations and school guidelines.  Communicate concerns about student well-being or behavior to the classroom teacher promptly and appropriately.  Operational and School Support  Assist in daily classroom routines including attendance, organization, and resource management.  Provide administrative support such as photocopying, filing, and preparing materials.  Request, organize, distribute materials and resources for the classroom or department as needed.  Supervise students during assigned duties (e.g., car pickup, lunch, recess) and assist during school trips and events.  Substitute for the classroom teacher as needed and ensure continuity of learning and care.  Support translation and communication between school and families when necessary, ensuring the teacher remains the primary point of contact.  Support and guide new Teaching Assistants as needed.  Professional Conduct and Growth  Model professionalism, punctuality, confidentiality, and responsible communication, including social media conduct.  Follow EAC policies, procedures, and safeguarding expectations as outlined in the Faculty/Staff Handbook.  Engage in professional development opportunities and participate in the Teaching Assistant Professional Growth and Evaluation process.  Collaborate positively with colleagues, offering support to new teaching assistants and contributing to a culture of collegiality and continuous improvement.  Additional Responsibilities  Engages in regular meetings and professional learning as part of the school’s commitment to continuous growth and collaboration.  Engage in the behavioral norms and expectations of the school.  Support student toileting needs, as per school norms, as assigned.  Follow the EAC Safeguarding Guide.  Working Conditions  Walk on paths and rough terrain  Lifting backpacks and school materials  Other duties, as assigned. Estamos em busca de uma Pessoa Desenvolvedora Back-end Node.js- Sênior.Procuramos alguém com perfil colaborativo, boa comunicação e habilidade para se adaptar a diferentes desafios técnicos e organizacionais. Você será uma peça chave no desenvolvimento de novas funcionalidades, garantindo qualidade e eficiência, além de colaborar com a equipe na definição de boas práticas de desenvolvimento. Se você curte diversão, energia, alegria, desafios criativos e é uma pessoa organizada, resolutiva, detalhista e orientada a resultados, vem com a gente!
Você será uma peça chave no desenvolvimento de novas funcionalidades, garantindo qualidade e eficiência, além de colaborar com a equipe na definição de boas práticas de desenvolvimento.Responsabilidades:
Desenvolver e manter aplicações back-end em Node.js, seguindo boas práticas de arquitetura e padrões de projeto.
Criar, documentar e integrar APIs RESTful de alta performance utilizando Type Script e Express.
Projetar e otimizar modelagem de dados em bancos relacionais (My SQL, Postgre SQL) e/ou No SQL (Mongo DB), garantindo queries performáticas e escalabilidade.
Utilizar ORMs como Type ORM, Sequelize ou Prisma para manipulação eficiente do banco de dados.
Versionar código com Git, adotando workflows (Git Flow, pull requests, code reviews) e boas práticas de controle de versão.
Trabalhar com Docker e docker-compose para criar ambientes de desenvolvimento e produção consistentes e reproduzíveis.
Garantir qualidade de código por meio de testes automatizados (unitários e de integração) usando Jest, Mocha ou similares.
Implementar mecanismos de cache (Redis, Memcached) e filas de mensagens (Rabbit MQ, AWS SQS/SNS, Kafka) para melhorar performance e escalabilidade.
Monitorar e depurar aplicações em produção utilizando ferramentas como Node Profiler, Datadog, New Relic ou Prometheus.
Implementar pipelines de CI/CD (Git Hub Actions, Git Lab CI, Jenkins) para deploy automatizado em AWS (ECS, Lambda, RDS, S3) ou Kubernetes.
Colaborar com times multidisciplinares (front-end, Dev Ops, QA) em metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban), participando de planning, daily e retrospectivas.Resquisitos:
Experiência sólida com Node.js e Type Script, aplicando padrões de projeto (Factory, Repository, Dependency Injection) e estruturação modular (Clean Architecture, DDD).
Uso de Express (ou Nest JS/Koa) para construção de APIs, dominando rotas, middlewares, tratamento de erros e validação de payload (class-validator, Joi, Celebrate).
Gerenciamento de pacotes com npm ou yarn, versionamento semântico (semver) e controle de dependências.
Testes Automatizados: domínio de frameworks como Jest ou Mocha + Chai, testes de integração (supertest) e uso de mocks/fakes.
Escalabilidade e Desempenho: experiência em cache (Redis), filas de mensagens (Rabbit MQ, Kafka, AWS SQS/SNS) e otimizações de consultas em bancos relacionais (índices, partições).
Performance e Debugging: uso de ferramentas como Node Profiler, Clinic.js, monitoramento com Datadog, New Relic ou Prometheus/Grafana.
Integração Contínua e Deploy: prática com CI/CD (Git Hub Actions, Git Lab CI, Jenkins) e deploy em AWS (ECS, Lambda, RDS, S3) ou ambientes Kubernetes.
Docker Avançado: criação de imagens otimizadas, multi-stage builds e configuração de docker-compose para desenvolvimento e produção.
Banco de Dados Relacional Avançado: My SQL ou Postgre SQL (índices, query profiling, replicação, particionamento).
APIs Performáticas e Seguras: experiência com Graph QL (Apollo Server), API Gateway, autenticação/autorização via OAuth2, JWT e versionamento de APIs.
Git Profundo: workflows Git Flow, rebase vs merge, cherry-pick e estratégias de branching para times grandes.Habilidades:Conhecimento em PHP (Laravel, Code Igniter, Symfony): será considerado um diferencial entender boas práticas de desenvolvimento back-end em PHP e migrar/integrações pontuais.
Experiência com React (ou Next.js): habilidade para colaborar com o front-end em aplicações isomórficas ou SPA, integrando APIs e estados globais (Redux, Context API).
Frameworks Node.js avançados: Nest JS (dependency injection, modules, providers), Koa ou Fastify para cenários de alta concorrência.
Infraestrutura como Código (Ia C): conhecimento em Terraform ou Cloud Formation para provisionamento de ambientes AWS.
Monitoramento e Observabilidade: uso de ELK Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana), Loki/Grafana, Open Telemetry para logs estruturados e métricas customizadas.
Event-Driven Architecture: trabalho com Kafka, Rabbit MQ, AWS SNS/SQS, Web Sockets (Socket.io) e arquiteturas orientadas a eventos.
Microservices: experiência em decomposição de sistemas monolíticos, deploy independente de serviços, comunicação via mensageria e API Gateway.
Segurança: implementação de práticas OWASP (mitigação de SQL Injection, XSS, CSRF), configuração de WAF (Cloudflare, AWS WAF) e auditoria de código.
Serverless: desenvolvimento e deploy de funções AWS Lambda em Node.js/Type Script, integração com Dynamo DB, S3 e triggers (SQS, API Gateway).Benefícios:

Ajuda de custo ou vale transporte via Ifood Benefícios.

Seguro de vida.
Licença maternidade estendida.
Espaço interativo com videogame.
Espaço de descompressão #DESLIGUER.
Frutas todos os dias
Estacionamento.
Treinamentos constantes e oportunidades de desenvolvimento.Condições de Trabalho:

title: Human resources manager
description:
JOB OVERVIEW:The Human Resources Manager plays a pivotal role in partnering with leadership to strategically coordinate the full employee lifecycle, from talent acquisition and onboarding to fostering continuous faculty and staff development. This role is crucial in ensuring successful integration into EAC's unique school culture and actively championing school-wide well-being initiatives.ORGANIZATIONAL RESULTS:Talent Development & Retention
Collaborates with school Leadership to monitor and administer professional development programs, ensuring alignment with local and international best practices in areas such as evidence-based instructional strategies and leadership development frameworks.
Maintains an accurate database of professional development experiences to inform future planning and ensure equitable allocation of resources.
Develops and implements career progression frameworks and provides individualized guidance in career development.
Proactively identifies and organizes relevant professional development opportunities (e.g., workshops, speakers, Ed Camps).Attracting & Retaining Talent
Manages the advertisement of positions and ensures the revision of job descriptions, interview questions, and tracking the overall hiring process, in collaboration with hiring managers.
Actively sources and solicits qualified applicants, reviews resumes, conducts initial and subsequent interviews, checks background on applicants, and makes recommendations to hiring managers, as requested.
Assists the Director of Finance and Administration in conducting compensation benchmarking and analysis, and utilizes systems to collect and analyze data on staff development, evaluation, retention, and attrition.
Organizes an overall calendar and individual events which recognize and celebrate the commitment of faculty & staff to EAC, fostering a positive and appreciative work environment.
Conducts interviews with faculty & staff as part of talent assessment and retention efforts.
Supporting performance reviews, tracking goal progress.
Actively sources and solicits qualified applicants from diverse backgrounds, reviews resumes with an equity lens, conducts initial and subsequent interviews, and makes recommendations to hiring managers, as requested, promoting a diverse candidate pool.Supporting a Positive & Ethical Culture
Administers employment contracts and oversees the comprehensive onboarding process for all new staff, including a schedule of activities, and facilitates training in child protection and data protection.
Provides comprehensive support and resources to foreign hire staff as they settle into life in Campinas and at EAC.
Plans and implements outings for staff to support inclusion and celebration of the local culture of Campinas.
Collaborates with school Leadership to monitor and administer professional development programs, ensuring alignment with local and international best practices in areas such as evidence-based instructional strategies, leadership development frameworks, and DEIJ best practices.Compliance and Child Protection
Collaborates with outsourced providers to ensure effective monitoring of EAC's complaint channel, facilitating appropriate incident reporting, including CIPA compliance.
Develops and delivers appropriate compliance training to staff and ensures the fully compliance with HR related laws
Establishes and oversees a robust school-wide system for mandatory child protection training for all EAC staff and third-party providers (liaising with counseling staff and Leadership).
Stays abreast of compliance-related laws and best practices in human resources, both nationally and internationally.
Proactively proposes and implements policy and procedure enhancements that support ethical behavior at EAC.
Develops and implements safer hiring protocols, including enhanced interview processes and comprehensive background, social media, and reference checks.Wellbeing
Recommends a comprehensive yearly plan, in line with the school's strategic direction, articulating meaningful developments in all aspects of staff wellness.
Conducts research and benchmarking exercises to ensure EAC's approach to staff wellness incorporates new ideas and initiatives.
Establishes mechanisms for regular staff feedback on wellness initiatives, utilizing data to inform continuous improvement.
Collaborates with Leadership to research and recommend new benefits for inclusion in EAC's approach to staff wellness.Health (physical and mental/emotional)
Develops, promotes, and publishes a comprehensive yearly plan of offerings and events at EAC that support the health and wellbeing of all faculty & staff.
Develops and promotes wellbeing activities for faculty & staff, making use of local resources such as guest speakers and trainers.
Acts as a primary resource, providing advice and guidance to staff on personal wellbeing, and sharing awareness of internal and external resources.
Serves as an internal consultant for faculty and staff on personal matters, such as stress management and relationships, offering evidence-based strategies and resources to support mental health and wellbeing and foster coping mechanisms.Other duties, as assigned.POSITION REQUIREMENTSBA in Human Resources, Psychology, or related field
5+ years of experience
HR policies, procedures, and best practices
Labor laws, employment regulations, and compliance (including CIPA)
HR Information Systems (HRIS)
Full recruitment and onboarding lifecycle
Compensation, benefits, and benchmarking
Professional development and training frameworks
Child protection and safeguarding protocols
Cultural competence and sensitivity.
Languages level requirement: B2 in English and C1 or above in PortugueseOther Skills (Desirable):
Excellent communication (verbal and written)
Strong organizational and time management abilities
High attention to detail
Problem-solving and conflict resolution
Interpersonal skills and empathy
Confidentiality and discretion
Data analysis
Adaptability and proactivity
Cultural awareness and sensitivity
Ability to foster an inclusive and equitable workplace culture.Child Safeguarding
Our school is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and have developed and adopted written guidelines (Code of Conduct) for appropriate and inappropriate behavior of adults towards children. We expect all staff, volunteers and other third parties to share this commitment and to review and affirm that they have read, understood, and will abide by the Code of Conduct. At our school, we use safer recruitment practice and pre-employment background checks, to maintain the highest standards of safeguarding and child safety.EAC’s Statement of Diversity and Inclusion
EAC embodies inclusion and diversity. As a community, we embrace the truth that diversity enriches us as individuals and as a community. Diversity includes recognizing individual differences in relation to cultural backgrounds, age, abilities, religious beliefs, gender and gender expression, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, religious beliefs, political beliefs, or other ideologies. The multiplicity of backgrounds and perspectives within our community reflect the entire world. Thus, we work to ensure that all members of our community enjoy mutual respect, are valued for who they are, and share a sense of belonging.

title: Preschool teaching assistant (maternity cover)
description:
JOB OVERVIEW:The Teaching Assistant at EAC is dedicated to the school’s mission, vision, and core values, demonstrating respect for diverse cultures and learners. Teaching Assistants (TAs) play an essential role in supporting high-quality, inquiry-based international education within the Montessori and IB Primary Years Programme (PYP). Assigned to one classroom or one subject area for the school year, Teaching Assistants collaborate closely with the Specialist, Homeroom, and/or Brazilian Studies teacher to support student learning, provide individualized assistance, and foster an environment of care and belonging.Teaching Assistants contribute to planning, instruction, assessment, and supervision, ensuring students are safe, engaged, and supported academically, socially, and emotionally. As active members of the Professional Learning Community, they participate in professional development and continuous reflection to enhance their effectiveness in supporting student growth.ORGANIZATIONAL RESULTS:

Model professionalism, collaboration, and ethical conduct in alignment with school policies and expectations.CORE RESPONSIBILITIES:Instructional Support and Student Learning
Collaborate with the classroom teacher to plan and deliver structured learning experiences for the whole class, small groups, and individual students.
Support students in understanding and reinforcing concepts introduced by the teacher, promoting independence and confidence in learning.
Prepare and organize resources, adapting materials and strategies to meet diverse student needs and cultural backgrounds.
Assist in providing formative feedback and collecting academic and behavioral data as directed by the teacher.

Apply logical and natural consequences in alignment with teacher expectations and school guidelines.
Communicate concerns about student well-being or behavior to the classroom teacher promptly and appropriately.Operational and School Support

Provide administrative support such as photocopying, filing, and preparing materials.
Request, organize, distribute materials and resources for the classroom or department as needed.
Supervise students during assigned duties (e.g., car pickup, lunch, recess) and assist during school trips and events.
Substitute for the classroom teacher as needed and ensure continuity of learning and care.
Support translation and communication between school and families when necessary, ensuring the teacher remains the primary point of contact.
Support and guide new Teaching Assistants as needed.Professional Conduct and Growth
Model professionalism, punctuality, confidentiality, and responsible communication, including social media conduct.
Follow EAC policies, procedures, and safeguarding expectations as outlined in the Faculty/Staff Handbook.
Engage in professional development opportunities and participate in the Teaching Assistant Professional Growth and Evaluation process.
Collaborate positively with colleagues, offering support to new teaching assistants and contributing to a culture of collegiality and continuous improvement.Additional Responsibilities
Engages in regular meetings and professional learning as part of the school’s commitment to continuous growth and collaboration.
Engage in the behavioral norms and expectations of the school.
Support student toileting needs, as per school norms, as assigned.
Follow the EAC Safeguarding Guide.Working Conditions
Walk on paths and rough terrain
Lifting backpacks and school materialsOther duties, as assigned.POSITION REQUIREMENTS:Degree in Pedagogy, preferred

Portuguese level required: B2 or aboveOther Skills (Desirable):

title: Senior backend engineering analyst
description:
Sinch is a global customer engagement platform that provides communication services for businesses across messaging, voice, and email. Sinch's services are used by more than 150,000 businesses, including many of the world's largest tech companies.
Join our development team as a Senior Backend Engineering Analyst ! You will be a key player in developing modern web applications and creating surprising new products for our clients. Our team focuses on building global-scale products and managing numerous direct integrations, including Meta (Facebook) for messaging. We also integrate with various platforms using APIs, queuing, and streaming technologies.
Activities
While responsibilities vary, in a general context, here's what we expect from you daily:
Deliver technology projects/products aligned with the company's strategic objectives (OKRs) , collaborating with the product team to suggest and develop new functionalities. Architect and develop APIs for incredible conversational experiences and integrations using modern development technologies. Develop and maintain scalable backend systems for a robust, global messaging platform (e.g., Whats App and SMS channels). Collaboratively develop and enhance distributed backend services that meet our customers' needs. Actively participate in discussions about product features and technical solutions to solve customer problems and scale our solution.
Master integrations and communications using REST APIs . Practice code versioning (Git) , with experience in Pull Requests and Code Review.
Work effectively in a team environment-we don't build software alone!
Requirements Solid experience in a functional language, preferably Elixir. Experience developing RESTful and g RPC APIs . Strong knowledge of distributed system architecture, data structures, algorithms, and software design patterns . Practical knowledge of Agile development methodologies . Solid understanding of relational databases . Experience with Unit Testing and Integration Testing .
English is a must. You will communicate with teams around the world daily. We expect you to have good English reading skills from the start and be willing to dedicate yourself to learning the language.
We are looking for people who: Enjoy working with talented teammates to raise the technical bar for the team, seeking new solutions and bringing improvements to existing processes. Adapt quickly to change. Have excellent communication skills for interpersonal relationships across different teams and hierarchical levels. In short, we seek someone willing to deep-dive into the processes, culture, people, and business of Sinch Latam, always prioritizing continuous improvement and contributing to the evolution of our products and services.
Nice to have: Knowledge of other functional languages like Erlang, Go, Rust, or Clojure . Knowledge of other languages like Java and Kotlin . Experience with distributed systems and microservices . Familiarity with container technology (e.g., Docker and Kubernetes ). Experience with messaging systems (e.g., Rabbit MQ, Kafka, Phoenix Pub Sub ). Knowledge of No SQL databases (e.g., Postgres, My SQL, Redis, Mongo DB, Elastic Search, etc.).
Benefits Stay healthy: We cover 100% of medical and dental plans for Sinchers and eligible dependents through Bradesco Saúde. Flexible benefits: With the Caju flexible benefit card, our Sinchers can choose to use benefits on food, education, and home office assistance. Family first: Our Sinchers can enjoy paid maternity leave for 180 days and paternity leave for 30 days. Plus, we provide daycare assistance for kids up to five years old. Everyday wellbeing: We partner with Wellhub to help Sinchers access gyms and wellness options. Secure your future : Our Partnership with Prudential life insurance provides coverage for all Sinchers in the events of unexpected absences, serious illness, accidents, and disabilities. Diversity and inclusion: We offer annual reimbursements for certain expenses related to disabilities and/or transgender needs.
Take a break: Our Sinchers can take a day off on their birthday to celebrate with their loved ones.
Our Hiring Process
In Sinch, we are committed to following a recruitment process that is fair, objective, consistent, and non-discriminatory. Our Talent Acquisition team, together with hiring managers and the rest of the interviewing team, persistently work towards identifying the candidates that best fit each open job, based on Sinch' s hiring needs and candidates' career expectations. We encourage applications from strong candidates with relevant professional backgrounds for this role. Not all applicants will meet all job requirements exactly! Even if you do not meet all job requirements, don't let that stop you from considering Sinch for the next step in your career. We are always open to candidates that could bring new ideas and perspectives to Sinch!

Knowledge Management Develop and maintain a robust knowledge base and internal documentation. Establish best practices for capturing, updating, and sharing critical customer-facing information.
Customer Engagement & Escalation Management Serve as the escalation point for key customers and complex support cases. Foster long-term customer relationships through effective communication and issue resolution.
Collaboration & Enablement Work closely with Sales, Operations, and Product teams to streamline support handoffs and improve customer journeys. Act as the voice of the customer to influence service improvements and product enhancements.
Reporting & Continuous Improvement Track KPIs and generate insights to drive process improvements. Establish reporting cadences for internal stakeholders and continuously evaluate performance metrics.
Qualifications
Experience 5+ years in a customer support or operations leadership role, ideally in an Io T environment, telco or B2 B SAAS environments. Proven experience scaling support teams and building processes from scratch. Strong understanding of technical support, customer operations, and logistics in LATAM markets.
Skills
Exceptional problem-solving and interpersonal skills. Strong organizational skills with attention to detail and follow-through. Comfortable with CRM and ticketing platforms (e.g., Freshdesk, Salesforce).
Mindset: Hands-on, entrepreneurial attitude with a passion for delivering outstanding customer experiences. Comfortable with ambiguity and fast-paced environments.
Technical Proficiency: Strong understanding of Io T architectures, including connectivity options (e.g., NB-Io T, LTE-M), device management, and cloud platforms.
Voice of the Customer & Innovation: Catalyst Act as an internal champion for customer needs. Translate feedback into actionable insights to influence product innovation and roadmap direction.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with customers, the sales team, and internal stakeholders to support customers, leveraging both Acceleronix and third-party offerings.
Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to convey complex technical information clearly to diverse audiences in Portuguese, Spanish, and English.
Customer-Centric Demonstrated ability to understand and align solutions with customer business goals.
Location Based in Brazil, Campinas.
Schedule: This position requires flexibility to work in shifts and be on-call, including weekends and holidays, to support customers across different time zones. Availability for emergency escalations and regional coordination is essential. Candidates must be prepared to adjust working hours as needed to ensure consistent service coverage and issue resolution.
Travel: The role requires frequent travel, approximately 25% of the time, both within Brazil and internationally, including multi-week business trips as needed.
This is a role at the forefront of a fast-growing tech sector, offering high-impact exposure to Io T innovation, digital transformation, and global ecosystems. You’ll join a collaborative and innovative environment within a dynamic international team, with ample opportunities for professional growth, leadership, and advancement. In addition to shaping and scaling global customer success operations, you'll benefit from competitive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package.
Join us at Acceleronix and be a part of shaping the future of Io T.

title: Jr flavourist - savoury applications
description:
Responsibilities
Develop and formulate stable, high-performing flavour solutions tailored to savoury food and beverage applications.
Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams across Kerry, including EUMs (End-Use Markets), to align flavour development with customer needs.
Participate in technical presentations and product demonstrations for clients, showcasing flavour performance and innovation.
Conduct daily organoleptic evaluations of raw materials as part of ongoing flavourist training and sensory development.
Maintain a working knowledge of global flavour regulations, labeling requirements, and compliance standards.
Support senior flavourists in internal and external flavour development projects, contributing to concept creation and execution.
Engage in sensory panels and other developmental activities to refine flavour perception and profiling skills.
Continuously study flavour chemistry, raw material interactions, and formulation techniques to enhance expertise.
Qualifications & Skills
Bachelor’s degree in Food Science, Chemistry, Life Sciences, Chemical Engineering, or equivalent industry experience.
Minimum of 5 years hands-on experience in flavour development, preferably in savoury applications.
Proven track record of successful commercial flavour creation and project management.
Prior experience working with savoury flavour profiles is essential.
Ability to independently lead flavour projects from concept to commercialization.
Skilled in leveraging Kerry’s proprietary technologies to deliver differentiated flavour solutions.
Strong troubleshooting abilities and adaptability in dynamic environments.
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills; able to work effectively with cross-functional teams.
Intermediate to advanced proficiency in English communication, both written and verbal.
Demonstrates professionalism, flexibility, and a proactive approach to continuous learning.
About Kerry
Kerry is the world's leading taste and nutrition company for the food, beverage and pharmaceutical industries. Every day we partner with customers to create healthier, tastier and more sustainable products that are consumed by billions of people across the world. Our vision is to be our customers' most valued partner, creating a world of sustainable nutrition. A career with Kerry offers you an opportunity to shape the future of food while providing you opportunities to explore and grow in a truly global environment.
